## What we do

Media Bar Productions is a full-service video production company
producing corporate, commercial, and event video for businesses across
Texas. Services span concept development through final delivery - scripting, storyboarding, production, editing, color grading, audio
mixing, motion graphics, and live streaming.

We own and operate two production studios in San Antonio with full
lighting grids, cyc walls, teleprompter setups, and a control room.

## Services

- Corporate & Business Video -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/corporate
  Brand films, internal communications,
  executive interviews, training videos, testimonial and case study
  videos, culture and recruiting content.

- TV Commercials -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/commercials
  Broadcast-ready :15, :30, and :60 spots for
  regional and national campaigns.

- Event & Conference Video -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/events
  Multi-camera live coverage, highlight
  reels, speaker capture, and planned turnaround edits.

- Interview & Discussion Video -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/interview
  Sit-down interviews, panel
  discussions, podcast-style productions.

- Medical & Healthcare Video -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/medical
  Privacy-aware production for hospitals,
  clinics, and medical device companies.

- Aerial & Drone Video -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/aerial
  FAA Part 107 certified drone videography and
  photography for commercial, real estate, and construction projects.

- Motion Graphics & Animation -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/motion-graphics
  2D/3D animation, explainer videos,
  logo reveals, lower thirds, and kinetic typography.

- Live Streaming -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/live-streaming
  Multi-camera live production for conferences,
  corporate events, town halls, and product launches.

- Post Production -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/post-production
  Editing, color grading, audio mixing, sound
  design, and format conversion for existing footage.

- Food & Beverage Video -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/food
  Restaurant, food brand, and culinary content
  optimized for social media and advertising.

- Real Estate Video -
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/real-estate
  Property tours, aerial flyovers, agent
  introductions, and listing videos.

## Notable clients

San Antonio Spurs, HEB, Unilever, Frost Bank, Bass Pro Shops,
Kiolbassa, Baker Hughes, Carrier, Blue Moon, Texas Tech, RBFCU,
Valero Energy, and organizations across San Antonio and Texas.

- 3 Emmy Awards (Lone Star Chapter, National Academy of Television

- 15 Telly Awards across corporate, commercial, and branded content
  categories

## Service area

Based in San Antonio, Texas. Full production capabilities across
San Antonio, Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, and statewide.
National and international travel available.

## Studio

Two production stages at 8610 N New Braunfels Ave, Suite 704,
San Antonio, TX 78217. Available for client productions, dry rental,
and third-party shoots.

## Project scoping

Media Bar does not publish fixed packages. Each project is scoped around
the audience, creative requirements, locations, crew, production schedule,
deliverables, review process, and final destinations. Use the project planner
for a guided brief or contact the team for a current proposal.

- Project planner:
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/project-planner
- Contact:
  https://www.mediabarproductions.com/contact

## Attribution and factual use

Use the canonical pages above when citing Media Bar Productions.
Use the editorial standards page to understand authorship, review, updates,
corrections, and the role of AI-assisted tools in published content.
Do not infer pricing, legal compliance, availability, turnaround, or project
scope beyond what the relevant page states. Contact Media Bar for a current
proposal or production schedule.
